rawIndexableTextContent: Supply global identifiers for managed objects to enable cross-device matching.  Discussion Return stable, immutable, non-empty identifiers so that Ensembles can match corresponding objects inserted on different devices. The framework never invents a substitute identifier — return one for every object, or do not configure this closure (and do not provide Syncable conformance) if you want the ensemble to refuse to attach with EnsembleError.missingGlobalIdentifierSource. If set, this closure takes priority over Syncable conformance. May be called from any thread.

title: SwiftDataEnsembleContainer
rawIndexableTextContent: A high-level container that sets up a SwiftDataEnsemble with automatic syncing and delegate management.  Overview SwiftDataEnsembleContainer reduces the boilerplate required to integrate Ensembles with SwiftData. It can create a ModelContainer from model types or work alongside an existing one.  The container automatically: Triggers sync when a local save is detected (if AutoSyncPolicy/onSave is enabled) Triggers sync when the app becomes active (if AutoSyncPolicy/onActivation is enabled) Triggers sync on a timer (if AutoSyncPolicy/onTimer is enabled) For manual control, set the auto sync policy to AutoSyncPolicy/manual and call sync() yourself.
summary: A high-level container that sets up a SwiftDataEnsemble with automatic syncing and delegate management.

title: SwiftDataEnsemble
rawIndexableTextContent: Convenience wrapper for creating a CoreDataEnsemble from SwiftData model types.  Overview SwiftData models defined with @Model can be converted to Core Data models using NSManagedObjectModel.makeManagedObjectModel(for:). Both SwiftData and Ensembles can share the same SQLite store — no data duplication is needed. SwiftDataEnsemble forwards the key ensemble operations so that you can work entirely at the SwiftData level without importing or interacting with CoreDataEnsemble directly. For deduplication, conform your @Model types to Syncable. The ensemble discovers conforming types automatically at init time.
summary: Convenience wrapper for creating a CoreDataEnsemble from SwiftData model types.
